sharePage.boostTitle: What's included in your free Profile Boost?
sharePage.teacherBoostIntro: Teachers with an active boost get seen first when students search:
teacherBoostPoints: Your profile appears at the top of search results — above non-boosted teachers.
More visibility means more proposals and demo requests from students who need your subject.
sharePage.studentBoostIntro: Students with an active boost get more responses on their posts:
studentBoostPoints: You receive Post Boost credits so your learning requirement posts appear above other posts.
More teachers see your request first, so you get faster proposals on the subjects you need.
sharePage.privateProfileBody: If your Instagram or Facebook account is private, you can still share your card as a post or story (visible to your followers), mention @padhai.pk, then upload a screenshot of your post below. Our team will verify it and apply your free 1-month boost.
sharePage.uploadSuccess: Screenshot received! Our team will verify your post and apply your free Profile Boost.

shareMessages.nativeSuccess: Share sheet opened with your card and caption — pick an app and tap Post.
shareMessages.nativeUnsupported: Native sharing isn't supported on this browser — use Facebook, Instagram, or LinkedIn below.
shareMessages.linkedinCopied: Caption copied & LinkedIn post opened — attach the downloaded card image, then click Post.
shareMessages.linkedinOpened: LinkedIn post opened with your caption — attach the downloaded card image, then click Post.
shareMessages.facebookCopied: Caption copied & Facebook composer opened — attach the downloaded card, paste caption if needed, tag Padhai.pk, then Post.
shareMessages.facebookOpened: Facebook composer opened — attach the downloaded card, tag Padhai.pk, then Post.
shareMessages.instagramCopied: Caption copied! In Instagram, create a new post or story, attach the downloaded card, paste the caption, tag @padhai.pk, then share.
shareMessages.instagramOpened: Card downloaded! In Instagram, create a new post or story, attach the card, tag @padhai.pk, then share.
shareMessages.platformNative: Share sheet opened with your card and caption — pick Instagram, Facebook, or LinkedIn and tap Post.
